beats.care: Fares are Rs 10–40. Change at Vadapalani for the airport, Egmore or Central. The last train leaves at 9 pm.
beats.what: PM Modi and CM Vijay opened the 14.64 km elevated stretch with 11 stations on Oct 11. Regular service began Monday.
beats.why: West Chennai gets metro for the first time, linking Porur and Poonamallee to the older network at Vadapalani.

cards.body: The minimum fare is Rs 10. Trains come every 10 minutes at weekday peaks, 15 minutes otherwise.
cards.caption: max fare, Poonamallee Bypass–Vadapalani

cards.body: Day-one riders asked for trains from 6 am to 11 pm for shift workers and more parking at Vadapalani. One said the AC bus costs Rs 50 and can take 1.5 hours at peak.
The trains are built to run without drivers, but two operators ride on board for now.

cards.q: Will you switch to the new metro line?

opts: It's where you switch to the older metro network
It's the only station with parking
cards.q: Why is Vadapalani station so important on this line?
cards.why: At Vadapalani you can change to Phase I lines for Egmore, Central, Alandur and the airport.

tldr: Chennai Metro's Poonamallee–Vadapalani line opened on Oct 11 and now runs daily from 7 am to 9 pm, with fares of Rs 10–40.
watch: Trains run with two operators for now; full driverless operation is expected by mid-2027.
